name: indonesia-map
title: Indonesia Map
description: Peta Indonesia per provinsi: provinsi muncul dari tengah, lalu singkatan, dan provinsi pilihan menyala bergantian. Di bingkai vertikal peta dibagi dua baris, barat dan timur.
useWhen: A value per Indonesian province needs to be shown as a map: pelanggan, penjualan, cabang, jangkauan.
Two or three provinces should glow in turn after the map has filled in.
avoidWhen: The data is by kabupaten or kota: this map stops at 33 provinces (no newer splits of Papua).
The data is for another country: use world-map or us-map.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Headline written on with a wipe.

variables.label: Source note
variables.description: Small credit line in the corner. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Data
variables.description: JSON object of province code (AC, SU, SB, RI, KR, JA, SS, BB, BE, LA, BT, JK, JB, JT, YO, JI, BA, NB, NT, KB, KT, KS, KI, SA, GO, ST, SR, SN, SG, MA, MU, PB, PA) or name to value.

variables.label: Bottom of the scale
variables.description: The value that gets the first colour of the ramp.

variables.label: Top of the scale
variables.description: The value that gets the last colour of the ramp.

variables.label: Highlighted provinces
variables.description: Provinces that glow in turn, by code or name, comma separated (up to 6).

variables.label: Colour ramp
variables.description: Colours from lowest to highest value, comma separated hex (2 to 6).

variables.label: No-data colour
variables.description: Fill for provinces without a value.

variables.label: Legend low label
variables.description: Text at the low end of the colour bar.

variables.label: Legend high label
variables.description: Text at the high end of the colour bar.

variables.label: Background start
variables.description: Start of the diagonal background gradient.

variables.label: Background end
variables.description: End of the diagonal background gradient.
